verdict.rationale: A government business-filing service could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows any machine-readable specification for an Ohio SOS machine channel. The Gateway and tax items describe human-facing portal features, OHID sign-in, and forms. The probes found only 403 walls at robots.txt on ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov, and nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched.
